purpose: Present a controlled notification inbox with local search, unread filtering and asynchronous item actions.
behaviorProvider: Shared SideSheet, SearchInput, Tabs and feedback components with local action serialization.

requirements.statement: Derive unread count and list entries from items. Read and dismissal callbacks request changes; the component does not mutate the supplied collection.
Apply local all/unread filtering and case-folded title/description search; both affect displayed items without changing their read state.
Serialize asynchronous read, dismiss and open-item actions through one pending guard; announce success and present rejected actions as errors.
Before actions designated as removing the current row from view, move focus to the panel search input so a disappearing row does not retain focus.
Delegate trigger, controlled/default open, dismissal and focus behavior to SideSheet, forwarding onOpenChangeComplete for host navigation coordination.
Show loading, supplied error, empty and no-match feedback according to current props and local filters; retry invokes the supplied callback.
Provide stable unique item ids and valid timestamps, update read/dismissed items after successful callbacks, and perform real navigation or persistence.
Manage fetching, retry/loading flags and remote cancellation. Closing the sheet is not a guarantee that pending host actions have stopped.
Own pattern or component styling consumes communication group tokens. Nested shared components retain their own group ownership; do not restyle their internals.

limitations: No fetching, subscription, persistence or automatic marking as read merely by opening the panel.
Callback success is reported locally and does not independently verify external state.
Action promises are not supplied an AbortSignal; hosts own cancellation and lifecycle policy.
